items.markdown:
Harbor Island in Bangkok features massive rooftop water parks, with premier locations at [The Mall Lifestore Bangkapi](https://harborlandgroup.com/harbor-island-the-mall-lifestore-bangkapi/) and [The Mall Lifestore Bangkae](https://harborlandgroup.com/) . These massive aquatic spaces offer family-friendly fun with various slides, lazy rivers, and play zones.[](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DV00wSRk95d/) [[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DV00wSRk95d/)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/thailandista/videos/save-this-new-biggest-rooftop-waterpark-in-thailand-harbor-island-the-mall-lifes/1029998343022151/)[[3]](https://www.facebook.com/100081742180022/videos/looking-for-something-unique-to-do-in-bangkokwelcome-to-harbor-island-the-larges/1835191990442743/)[[4]](https://www.facebook.com/harborlandplayground/posts/essential-information-to-consider-before-visiting-harbor-island-explore-this-pos/1142462294586682/)

Locations & Access

- **Bangkapi Branch:** 3rd Floor, The Mall Lifestore Bangkapi , Lat Phrao Road; accessible via the MRT Yellow Line (Bang Kapi Station).
- **Bangkae Branch:** 3rd Floor, The Mall Lifestore Bangkae, Phetkasem Road; accessible via the MRT Blue Line (Lak Song Station).[](https://harborlandgroup.com/harbor-island-the-mall-lifestore-bangkapi/) [[1]](https://harborlandgroup.com/harbor-island-the-mall-lifestore-bangkapi/)[[2]](https://harborlandgroup.com/harbor-island-the-mall-lifestore-bangkae/)

Key Features & Zones

- **Super Island:** Huge aqua towers packed with multiple high-thrill and family water slides.
- **Lazy Island:** A 200-meter lazy river with interactive water effects.
- **Sky Rider:** High aerial gliders and roller-coaster ziplines.
- **Play & Art Zones:** Dedicated dry and wet areas including Little Island, Toys Island, Sand Island, and Art Island for creative crafting.[](https://harborlandgroup.com/harbor-island-the-mall-lifestore-bangkapi/) 

Hours & Operations

- **Daily Hours:** 11:00 AM – 7:30 PM (Opening at 10:30 AM on long weekends/holidays).
- **Admission:** Tickets cover access to play zones with amenities like tubes and safety oversight included.[](https://harborlandgroup.com/harbor-island-the-mall-lifestore-bangkapi/)
